Don't-Lie is taking on **5 design partners** in the lead-up to the EU AI Act
Article 12 enforcement deadline (2 Aug 2026). In exchange for free Pro/Team
seats for 6 months, we ask for a 30-minute weekly call and the right to quote
your use case (anonymized unless you opt in).

## You qualify if

- [ ] You build, deploy, or audit LLM-based products in a regulated industry
      (healthcare, financial services, legal, insurance, EU public sector, or
      US federal contracting).
- [ ] You spend at least $5K/mo on OpenAI, Anthropic, MiniMax, Gemini, or
      comparable APIs.
- [ ] You have an internal compliance owner (CISO, GC, GRC lead, or external
      auditor) who can speak to what evidence they need.
- [ ] You can ship a 30-day integration pilot in the next quarter.

## What you get

- Free Pro or Team plan for 6 months (waived; no card).
- Direct Slack channel with the maintainer.
- Roadmap influence — your use case gets prioritized.
- Co-marketing: your case study on `dontlie.dev` (with your approval).

## What we ask

- 30 min/week for 6 weeks. We record the call for our own use; you can review
  the recording before we transcribe.
- Permission to publish an anonymized use case. We will never name your
  company without explicit written approval.
- A 1-page "what we shipped" writeup at the end of the pilot.

## Tell us about you

- Company / organization (and whether you can be named publicly):
- Industry:
- What you're building with LLMs:
- Your current evidence / audit stack (Langfuse, Helicone, in-house, nothing):
- Compliance owner and their biggest concern about AI logs right now:
- Timeline for the EU AI Act / HIPAA / SOC 2 / NY DFS deadline you're targeting:
- Best way to reach you (email is fine; we'll move to Slack after intro):

## What happens next

We review applications weekly. We aim to reply within 7 days, even if it's
"not a fit right now" with a reason. We will never sell or share your
information.
